items.micro_skill: find the rule from the gaps between terms
items.stem: Find the next number in the series: 7, 12, 17, 22, 27, ___

reveal.terms: A series follows one rule. Test the gaps first; if the gaps change, test the gaps of the gaps, then multiplication, then two series taking turns.
reveal.shortcut: Write the differences under the terms; most series show their rule there.
reveal.why_correct: The rule is: add 5 each time. Applied to 27, the next term is 32. Each wrong choice comes from a rule that fits only part of the series.

why_wrong.o4: 35 adds 8, a step not in the series.

method_steps.1_asked: Find the next number in the series: 7, 12, 17, 22, 27, ___
method_steps.3_method: A series follows one rule. Test the gaps first; if the gaps change, test the gaps of the gaps, then multiplication, then two series taking turns.
method_steps.4_why: The method matches what is asked: a series follows one rule.
method_steps.5_solve_by_hand: The rule is: add 5 each time. Applied to 27, the next term is 32. Each wrong choice comes from a rule that fits only part of the series.
method_steps.6_check: Put 32 back into the problem (or redo the last step in reverse) and confirm every given number is used once.
method_steps.7_distractors: 54: 54 doubles the last term. 31: 31 adds 4 instead of 5. 35: 35 adds 8, a step not in the series.
method_steps.8_shortcut: Write the differences under the terms; most series show their rule there.
